notes: §2002:15.41.2 AR3 - §2002:15.41.2 AR3 requires locale-name-1 to be a SPECIAL-NAMES locale; the case declares FR, GER, USA, XX by LOCALE clauses and uses each as locale-name-1 of LOCALE-DATE; it compiles and runs, so every output line shows the granted form accepted (the refusal of an undeclared name, COBOL1664, is the existing pb64t4-locale-function-name-undeclared case, refuse-at 2002). Expected lines derived from the 2002 text before the run; G2LDT01 at --std 2002 on the pinned build (tree dc1f2dcce8) printed exactly the derived .out.
